STRUCTURE MIRRORS THE PRECEDENT EXACTLY, because the reasoning transfers rather than merely the layout: kind constant written once; ONE frozen `ENV_EXAMPLE_SYNC_CODE_LAYER_MAP`; `ENV_EXAMPLE_SYNC_CODES` DERIVED from `Object.keys(...)` and never restated; `envExampleSyncRefusal(code, detail)` accepting NO layer argument so a disagreeing pair cannot be expressed; the distributed mapped type `EnvExampleSyncRefusalFor<C>` so even a hand-built literal that bypasses the factory is a compile error; and `isEnvExampleSyncRefusal` checking `Object.hasOwn` for both `ok` and `code` so a prototype-planted code cannot be admitted.

FOUR CODES, ONE PER THING THAT CAN ACTUALLY REFUSE, no speculative fifth:
  ENV_EXAMPLE_COMMIT_FAILED          -> REPOSITORY_DELIVERY
  ENV_EXAMPLE_CONTRACT_UNAPPROVED    -> DAEMON_PREREQUISITE
  ENV_EXAMPLE_REPOSITORY_UNBOUND     -> PROJECT_REDUCER
  ENV_EXAMPLE_REPOSITORY_UNREADABLE  -> RUNNER_WORKSPACE

All four code names verified ABSENT tree-wide before I chose them (`git grep -c` returns 0 files each), so none collides with an existing vocabulary.

EVERY LAYER REUSES A ROSTERED ONE -- risk F held, and checked by locating the exported constant that declares each VALUE rather than by assuming the string looked familiar:

  "PROJECT_REDUCER"      = PROJECT_REDUCER_LAYER      recovery/recovery-completion-evidence.ts:43
  "RUNNER_WORKSPACE"     = RUNNER_WORKSPACE_LAYER     work/foundation-attempt-contracts.ts:34
  "REPOSITORY_DELIVERY"  = REPOSITORY_DELIVERY_LAYER  orchestrator/repository-delivery-contracts.ts:3
No new `*_LAYER` constant, so no 4+2+2 roster backfill and no `pnpm test:security` obligation. Step 5 pins each equality BY IMPORT, which is where the dependency cost is free.

TWO NAMING TRAPS AVOIDED DELIBERATELY, both recorded in the docblock so the next editor does not undo them. (1) The constant is `..._CODE_LAYER_MAP`, not `..._LAYERS`: the security lane's `DECLARATION_PATTERN` and `PRIVATE_DECLARATION_PATTERN` both require the declared name to end in LAYER/LAYERS/BOUNDARIES immediately before the `=`, so the `_MAP` tail keeps this module's scan-minus-roster delta at zero. Renaming it would silently demand a backfill. (2) Layer values are string LITERALS, not imports of those four constants -- importing them would drag @moe/store, @moe/core, @moe/runner and @moe/scheduler into a module that must stay standalone-loadable.

The em-dashes in the docblock are the precedent's own convention, not drift: release-decide-contracts.ts carries 5 non-ASCII lines and 751 daemon source files do. This row's DoD carries no ASCII-only clause (that was the control-room scheduler scan on a different row).
